name: noaa-storm-events
title: US storm events, 2024 and 2025
summary: Count, total and check NOAA's US storm records for 2024 and 2025: events and episodes, damage written with K, M and B suffixes, deaths and injuries, tornado paths, hail and wind, and time zones.
description: Each task gives the AI rows of NOAA's Storm Events Database for 2024 or 2025, the National Weather Service's record of storms, floods, hail, wind and other significant weather, with the deaths, injuries and damage estimates entered for each event. The question states its own definitions, such as an area, an event type or how an empty cell counts, and asks for exact figures: counts, damage totals, shares, rankings, averages and durations. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

upstream.name: Storm Events Database

families.name: Event counts
families.what: Events counted apart from episodes, and county rows apart from forecast zone rows, by month, area and type.

families.name: Damage amounts
families.what: Property and crop damage read from amounts with K, M and B suffixes, with an empty cell kept apart from zero.

families.name: Casualties
families.what: Deaths and injuries summed by state, event type and class of tornado rating.

families.name: Concentration
families.what: How much of the damage or hail falls in a few areas, as shares, rankings and a Herfindahl index.

families.name: Year over year
families.what: Counts compared between years, between quarters and over a cold season, as the question defines them.

families.name: Tornado paths
families.what: Tornado segments by rating, their lengths, widths and areas, and segments followed across county lines.

families.name: Magnitudes
families.what: Hail sizes and wind gusts read in the right unit, with measured gusts kept apart from estimated ones.

families.name: Durations and time
families.what: How long events lasted, events that run a whole month, and local times turned into UTC with the offset given.

families.name: Location joins
families.what: Events joined to their location points without counting any row twice.

families.name: Data check
families.what: Identifiers, dates, magnitudes and damage cells checked against each other, without false alarms.
